pages.title: Siberian Ibex
pages.text: The Siberian ibex ($(o)Capra sibirica$()) is the largest ibex, found in the mountains of Central Asia.$(br2)Males have very long, ridged horns, a long dark beard and, in winter, a pale saddle patch on the back.$(br2)It lives in herds on steep, rocky slopes, often near the snow line.
